summary.text: Mark Pugh is the Republican candidate for Delaware State Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Kyra Hoffner.
He was also the Republican candidate for the seat in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Mark Pugh ran for Delaware State Senate District 14 in 2022, losing to Kyra Hoffner 51.8% to 48.2%, a margin of 593 votes.
